package integration

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"example.com/integration/internal/db"
	"example.com/integration/internal/models"
	"example.com/integration/internal/repository"
	pg "example.com/integration/migrations/pg"
	"github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
)

type upsertEntity struct {
	ID    int64  `db:"id" conflict:"true"`
	Value string `db:"value"`
}

type valueEntity struct {
	ID int64 `db:"id"`
}

func (e valueEntity) GetID() int64 { return e.ID }

type badEntity struct {
	ID int64 `db:"id"`
}

func (e *badEntity) GetID() int64             { return e.ID }
func (e *badEntity) GetCreatedAt() time.Time  { return time.Time{} }
func (e *badEntity) GetUpdatedAt() time.Time  { return time.Time{} }
func (e *badEntity) GetDeletedAt() *time.Time { return nil }

type reservedColumn struct {
	ID    int64  `db:"id" autoincrement:"true"`
	Order string `db:"order" conflict:"true"`
	Value string `db:"value"`
}

func (r *reservedColumn) GetID() int64 { return r.ID }

func checkReservedColumns(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn, err := db.Connect(ctx, os.Getenv("CAPG_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	if _, err := conn.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE TABLE reserved_columns (id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, "order" TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL)`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	row := &reservedColumn{Order: "first", Value: "created"}
	if err := db.Save(ctx, conn, "reserved_columns", row); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create: %v", err)
	}
	row.Value = "updated"
	if err := db.Save(ctx, conn, "reserved_columns", row); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("update: %v", err)
	}
	if err := db.SaveMany(ctx, conn, "reserved_columns", []reservedColumn{{Order: "second", Value: "bulk"}}, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("bulk: %v", err)
	}
	if err := db.SaveOrUpdateT(ctx, conn, "reserved_columns", reservedColumn{Order: "first", Value: "upsert"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("upsert: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := db.SaveT(ctx, conn, "reserved_columns", reservedColumn{Order: "third", Value: "saveT"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SaveT: %v", err)
	}
	var value string
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &value, `SELECT value FROM reserved_columns WHERE "order" = 'first'`); err != nil || value != "upsert" {
		t.Fatalf("stored value: %q, %v", value, err)
	}
}

func checkConnectionTimeZone(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	admin, err := db.Connect(ctx, os.Getenv("CAPG_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer admin.Close()
	if _, err := admin.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE ROLE capg_tz_test LOGIN PASSWORD 'a  b'`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(os.Getenv("CAPG_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dsn := fmt.Sprintf("host=%s port=%s user=capg_tz_test password='a  b' dbname=capg_test sslmode=disable timezone='UTC'", u.Hostname(), u.Port())
	conn, err := db.ConnectWithTZ(ctx, dsn, "Europe/Moscow")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect with quoted password: %v", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	var tz string
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &tz, "SHOW TimeZone"); err != nil || tz != "Europe/Moscow" {
		t.Fatalf("time zone: %q, %v", tz, err)
	}
}

func checkMigrationSpecialPaths(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn, err := db.Connect(ctx, os.Getenv("CAPG_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp(".", "migration #?% space-")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(dir)
	entries, err := os.ReadDir("migrations/pg/migrations")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		contents, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("migrations/pg/migrations", entry.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name()), contents, 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{dir, abs} {
		if err := pg.MigrationUp(ctx, conn.DB, path, 0, false); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("migration path %q: %v", path, err)
		}
	}
}

func checkMigrationReleasesConnection(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn, err := db.Connect(ctx, os.Getenv("CAPG_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	conn.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	cancel()
	for name, run := range map[string]func() error{
		"Migration":     func() error { return pg.Migration(cancelled, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", false) },
		"MigrationUp":   func() error { return pg.MigrationUp(cancelled, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 0, false) },
		"MigrationDown": func() error { return pg.MigrationDown(cancelled, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 1, false) },
	} {
		if err := run(); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Errorf("%s with cancelled context: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	held, err := conn.Conn(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	waitCtx, stop := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 50*time.Millisecond)
	err = pg.MigrationUp(waitCtx, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 0, false)
	stop()
	if closeErr := held.Close(); closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(closeErr)
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("waiting for connection: %v", err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if err := pg.MigrationUp(ctx, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 0, false); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if inUse := conn.Stats().InUse; inUse != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("connections still in use: %d", inUse)
		}
	}
	if err := pg.MigrationUp(ctx, conn.DB, "missing-migration-directory", 0, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected missing migration source error")
	}
	if inUse := conn.Stats().InUse; inUse != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("connections still in use after error: %d", inUse)
	}
	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := conn.PingContext(pingCtx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("pool unusable after migration: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn, err := db.Connect(ctx, os.Getenv("CAPG_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if conn != nil {
		defer conn.Close()
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var table *string
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &table, "SELECT to_regclass('public.products')::text"); err != nil || table != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Connect unexpectedly ran migrations: %v, %v", table, err)
	}
	if err := pg.MigrationUp(ctx, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 0, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var version int
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &version, "SHOW server_version_num"); err != nil || version < 180000 || version >= 190000 {
		t.Fatalf("expected PostgreSQL 18, got %d: %v", version, err)
	}
	repo := repository.NewProduct(conn)
	var nilDB *sqlx.DB
	if err := db.Save(ctx, nilDB, "products", &models.Product{}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil database should fail")
	}
	var nilProduct *models.Product
	if err := db.Save(ctx, conn, "products", nilProduct); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil entity should fail")
	}
	if err := db.Save(ctx, conn, "products", valueEntity{}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("value entity should fail")
	}
	if err := db.Save(ctx, conn, "products", &badEntity{}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing timestamp field should fail")
	}
	if err := db.SaveMany(ctx, conn, "products", []*models.Product{nil}, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil bulk item should fail")
	}
	zero := time.Time{}
	product := &models.Product{DeletedAt: &zero}
	if err := repo.Save(ctx, product); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if product.ID <= 0 || product.CreatedAt.IsZero() || product.DeletedAt != nil {
		t.Fatalf("created product: %+v", product)
	}
	found, err := repo.ByID(ctx, product.ID)
	if err != nil || found.ID != product.ID {
		t.Fatalf("ByID: %+v, %v", found, err)
	}
	oldUpdated := product.UpdatedAt
	time.Sleep(2 * time.Millisecond)
	if err := repo.Save(ctx, product); err != nil || !product.UpdatedAt.After(oldUpdated) {
		t.Fatalf("update: %+v, %v", product, err)
	}
	if err := repo.Save(ctx, &models.Product{ID: 987654321}); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		t.Fatalf("updating a missing product: %v", err)
	}
	if err := repo.Delete(ctx, product.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("delete: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := repo.ByID(ctx, product.ID); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		t.Fatalf("deleted product visible: %v", err)
	}
	if err := repo.Save(ctx, product); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		t.Fatalf("saving deleted product should not restore it: %v", err)
	}
	deleted, err := repo.ByIDIncludingDeleted(ctx, product.ID)
	if err != nil || deleted.DeletedAt == nil {
		t.Fatalf("find deleted: %+v, %v", deleted, err)
	}
	if err := repo.Delete(ctx, product.ID); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		t.Fatalf("repeat delete: %v", err)
	}
	if err := repo.Restore(ctx, product.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore: %v", err)
	}
	if restored, err := repo.ByID(ctx, product.ID); err != nil || restored.DeletedAt != nil {
		t.Fatalf("find restored: %+v, %v", restored, err)
	}
	if err := repo.Restore(ctx, product.ID); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		t.Fatalf("repeat restore: %v", err)
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{"public.products", `"products"`, "products;DROP", "", "1bad"} {
		if err := db.Save(ctx, conn, bad, &models.Product{}); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("Save accepted table %q", bad)
		}
		if err := db.Create(ctx, conn, bad, &models.Product{}); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("Create accepted table %q", bad)
		}
		if _, err := db.SaveT(ctx, conn, bad, models.Product{}); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("SaveT accepted table %q", bad)
		}
		if err := db.SaveMany(ctx, conn, bad, []models.Product{{}}, false); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("SaveMany accepted table %q", bad)
		}
		if err := db.SaveOrUpdateT(ctx, conn, bad, models.Product{}); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("SaveOrUpdateT accepted table %q", bad)
		}
	}
	orders := repository.NewOrder(conn)
	order := &models.Order{}
	if err := orders.Save(ctx, order); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("save reserved-word table: %v", err)
	}
	if got, err := orders.ByID(ctx, order.ID); err != nil || got.ID != order.ID {
		t.Fatalf("read reserved-word table: %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
	if inserted, err := db.SaveT(ctx, conn, "order", models.Order{}); err != nil || !inserted {
		t.Fatalf("SaveT on reserved table: %v, %v", inserted, err)
	}
	if err := db.SaveMany(ctx, conn, "order", []models.Order{{}}, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SaveMany on reserved table: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := conn.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE TABLE "select" (id bigint primary key, value text not null)`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := db.SaveOrUpdateT(ctx, conn, "select", upsertEntity{ID: 1, Value: "first"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("upsert reserved table: %v", err)
	}
	if err := db.SaveOrUpdateT(ctx, conn, "select", upsertEntity{ID: 1, Value: "second"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("update reserved table: %v", err)
	}
	var upsertValue string
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &upsertValue, `SELECT value FROM "select" WHERE id=1`); err != nil || upsertValue != "second" {
		t.Fatalf("upsert value: %q, %v", upsertValue, err)
	}
	t.Run("repository transaction commit and rollback", func(t *testing.T) {
		if _, err := conn.ExecContext(ctx, `ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		first, second := &models.Product{}, &models.Product{}
		if err := repo.Save(ctx, first); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := repo.Save(ctx, second); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := repo.RenamePair(ctx, first.ID, second.ID, "first", "second"); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var name string
		if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &name, `SELECT name FROM products WHERE id=$1`, first.ID); err != nil || name != "first" {
			t.Fatalf("committed name = %q, %v", name, err)
		}
		if err := repo.RenamePair(ctx, first.ID, -1, "changed", "missing"); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			t.Fatalf("expected missing product error: %v", err)
		}
		if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &name, `SELECT name FROM products WHERE id=$1`, first.ID); err != nil || name != "first" {
			t.Fatalf("rollback name = %q, %v", name, err)
		}
	})
	cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	cancel()
	if _, err := repo.ByID(cancelled, product.ID); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("cancelled read: %v", err)
	}
	if err := repo.Save(cancelled, &models.Product{}); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("cancelled save: %v", err)
	}
	if got := repository.NewWidget(conn).Table(); got != "widgets" {
		t.Fatalf("simple repository table: %q", got)
	}

	widget := &models.Widget{}
	if err := db.Create(ctx, conn, "widgets", widget); err != nil || widget.ID <= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("create ID-only widget: %+v, %v", widget, err)
	}
	if err := pg.MigrationDown(ctx, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 1, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &table, "SELECT to_regclass('public.price_history')::text"); err != nil || table != nil {
		t.Fatalf("rollback did not remove custom migration table: %v, %v", table, err)
	}
	if err := pg.MigrationDown(ctx, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 1, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &table, "SELECT to_regclass('public.widgets')::text"); err != nil || table != nil {
		t.Fatalf("rollback did not remove widgets: %v, %v", table, err)
	}
	if err := pg.MigrationUp(ctx, conn.DB, "migrations/pg/migrations", 0, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := conn.GetContext(ctx, &table, "SELECT to_regclass('public.widgets')::text"); err != nil || table == nil {
		t.Fatalf("migration did not recreate widgets: %v, %v", table, err)
	}
	t.Run("reserved columns", checkReservedColumns)
	t.Run("connection time zone", checkConnectionTimeZone)
	t.Run("migration special paths", checkMigrationSpecialPaths)
	t.Run("migration releases connection", checkMigrationReleasesConnection)
}
